beats.text: This area in the Persian Gulf was quiet through the previous day.
At 03:00 UTC the system committed a public forecast: 98% jamming probability for 15:00 UTC — 12 hours ahead.
15:00 UTC arrived: GNSS integrity degraded exactly here. Verified hit — called 12 hours in advance, provably committed before the event.
